name: SiteWork & Civil
short_desc: Earthwork, excavation, utilities, paving, grading, and site development takeoffs.
overview: Site and civil takeoffs covering everything that happens before vertical construction begins — from initial earthwork through finished paving and utility tie-ins.
what_we_cover: Site utilities — water, sewer, storm drainage
what_you_receive: Marked-up site plans showing measured areas
typical_applications: Land development, subdivisions, commercial pad sites, road and utility infrastructure projects.

name: Concrete & Masonry
short_desc: Accurate takeoffs for foundations, concrete structures, reinforcing, and masonry work.
overview: Foundation-through-structure concrete and masonry quantities, verified against rebar schedules and formwork requirements for accurate bid pricing.
what_we_cover: CMU block and brick veneer counts
what_you_receive: Rebar schedule cross-referenced to structural drawings
typical_applications: Foundations for residential and commercial buildings, parking structures, retaining walls, masonry building envelopes.

name: Structural & Building Envelope
short_desc: Estimating structural metals, framing, roofing, waterproofing, doors, windows, and glazing.
overview: Structural steel, framing, and the full building envelope — the systems that carry loads and separate interior from exterior.
what_we_cover: Doors, windows, and curtain wall glazing
what_you_receive: Structural steel tonnage and connection schedule
typical_applications: Commercial and industrial steel structures, multi-family framing packages, envelope retrofits, roofing replacement projects.

name: Architectural & Interior Finishes
short_desc: Detailed quantities for drywall, ceilings, flooring, painting, finishes, and interior specialties.
overview: Complete interior finish-out quantities — the trades that turn a structural shell into a finished, occupiable space.
what_we_cover: Drywall board counts and metal stud framing
Acoustic ceiling tile and grid systems
Flooring — tile, carpet, LVP, and underlayment
Interior and exterior paint surface area
typical_applications: Commercial tenant improvements, multi-family interiors, hospitality and retail buildouts, residential remodels.

name: MEP & Building Systems
short_desc: Comprehensive estimating for HVAC, plumbing, fire protection, electrical, and low-voltage systems.
overview: Full mechanical, electrical, and plumbing takeoffs covering ductwork, piping, wiring, and fire/life-safety systems across a project.
what_we_cover: Plumbing pipe lengths, fittings, and fixtures
typical_applications: Commercial and institutional HVAC replacements, multi-family plumbing risers, ground-up MEP rough-in packages.

name: Equipment & Specialty Construction
short_desc: Takeoffs for equipment, specialties, furnishings, conveying systems, and specialty construction.
overview: Purpose-built structures and process equipment that fall outside standard building trades — from conveying systems to special-use facilities.
what_we_cover: Special construction — pre-engineered buildings, fabric structures
Loading dock and industrial equipment takeoffs
typical_applications: Industrial and warehouse facilities, pre-engineered metal buildings, specialty process/manufacturing projects.

name: Design & Drafting
short_desc: BIM modeling, CAD drafting, plan drafting, shop drawings, as-builts, and 3D documentation.
overview: Technical drafting and modeling services that support estimation and construction documentation — from concept drawings to fully coordinated BIM models.
what_you_receive: Drafted plan sets in your required format
Coordinated BIM model files where applicable
typical_applications: Design-build projects, shop drawing submittals, as-built record sets, BIM coordination for multi-trade projects.
